metadata.description: Working modes and working docs: skills that change how an AI assistant thinks through a problem, and carry work across sessions.

plugins.name: working-modes
plugins.description: Seven session stances for an AI assistant: explorer, interrogator, evaluator, planner, implementer, troubleshooter, validator. Each sets how the assistant works for the rest of the session; invoked by name.

plugins.name: working-docs
plugins.description: Session-continuity skills that capture state and carry work across sessions: handoff-doc, working-doc, kickoff-prompt.
